name: Preparation Day
overview: The Preparation Day, as described in the Gospels, refers to the day before the Sabbath and often coincides with the day of the Passover. It was a time when the Jewish leaders made arrangements, such as securing Jesus’ tomb (Matthew 27:62), and when followers prepared spices and ointments in anticipation of the Sabbath rest (Luke 23:54, 56; Mark 16:1). This day highlights the careful observance of God's commandments regarding the Sabbath and the significance of timing in the events surrounding Christ’s crucifixion and resurrection (Mark 15:42; John 19:14).
